pages.title: Gather Scattered Experience
pages.text: A Black Hole absorbs nearby experience orbs and eventually produces Petrified Orbs. Keep one near a regular experience source, then feed its output to the forge.

pages.title: Bring Two Materials Together
pages.text: Drop Dark Matter and Corrupti Dust close together. If they meet in an air block, one of each is consumed to form a Black Hole.
